[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided 12 unique sourdough bread recipe ideas:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Fig and Rosemary Sourdough: Infuse dough with dried figs and fresh rosemary leaves.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Kalamata Olive and Sun-dried Tomato Sourdough: Add kalamata olives and sun-dried tomatoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Cranberry Orange Pecan Sourdough: Dried cranberries, orange zest, and toasted pecans.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Garlic and Chive Sourdough: Mix in roasted garlic and chopped chives.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Rye and Caraway Sourdough: Combine rye flour with caraway seeds.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Pumpkin and Sage Sourdough: Add roasted pumpkin puree and fresh sage leaves.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Cheddar and Chive Sourdough: Mix in grated cheddar cheese and chopped chives.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Walnut and Cranberry Sourdough: Combine walnuts with dried cranberries.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Spicy Jalapeño and Cheddar Sourdough: Add diced jalapeños and grated cheddar cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Herb de Provence Sourdough: Mix in dried herbs like thyme, rosemary, and lavender.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 11. Apple and Cinnamon Sourdough: Add diced apples and cinnamon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 12. Miso and Honey Sourdough: Combine miso paste with honey.  
[PREFERENCE] User loves the ideas provided by the assistant.  
[PREFERENCE] User is particularly interested in the Fig and Rosemary Sourdough and the Cranberry Orange Pecan Sourdough.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for incorporating figs into the Fig and Rosemary Sourdough:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Rehydrate dried figs by soaking them in water or liquid for at least 30 minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Chop figs into small pieces for even distribution.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Add chopped figs during the autolyse phase or first fold.
